rationale: Montreal Gateway Terminals Partnership is one current Canadian marine-container-terminal operator covering Cast and Racine. Direct manager, company, former-owner and Port evidence supports the canonical boundary, Axium's active 2015 ownership, Morgan Stanley's realized 2007-2015 period and continued operations. No later sale or signed pending exit was identified.

aliases: Terminaux Montréal Gateway Société en commandite
identityResolution.platformBoundary: Count one operator covering Cast and Racine. The Port of Montreal is the landlord and port authority; Termont Montreal operates Maisonneuve and Viau separately; terminals, berths, cranes, leases and affiliate entities are not additional PortCos.
identityResolution.duplicateDecision: No exact production or evaluated-seed company exists. Create one company and no asset-level duplicates.

ownershipResolution.managerAliasDecision: Treat Fiera Axium Infrastructure Inc. as the predecessor manager name of Axium Infrastructure. Store Fiera Axium Infrastructure Canada II L.P. as the disclosed vehicle because no matching production-curated Fund row exists.

operatingResolution.description: Montreal Gateway Terminals Partnership is a common-user marine container terminal operator at the Port of Montreal. It operates Cast and Racine as one intermodal platform serving global shipping lines and cargo owners through vessel, yard, reefer, gate and rail/truck-transfer services.
operatingResolution.productsAndServices: Marine-container handling, yard and reefer services, storage, gates and rail/truck transfer.
operatingResolution.customersAndEndMarkets: Global shipping lines and cargo owners serving Canada and the U.S. Midwest and Northeast.
operatingResolution.footprint: Cast/Section 77 and Racine/Section 62 at the Port of Montreal, connected to CN, CPKC and regional highways.
disclosedScale: 800,000 TEU effective handling capacity at Cast
500,000 TEU effective handling capacity at Racine

acquisitionExitCheck.entry: The Axium-led consortium completed a 100% acquisition from Morgan Stanley Infrastructure Partners on March 5, 2015 and announced it on March 6. Fiera Axium Infrastructure Canada II L.P. was the disclosed Axium vehicle; individual consortium percentages were not published.
acquisitionExitCheck.currentStatus: CLOSED_ACTIVE. Axium's live portfolio lists the asset as operational, current company and Port pages show active Cast-and-Racine operations, and the 2025 financing identified FA MGT as the parent without transferring equity.
acquisitionExitCheck.subsequentExitSearch: Targeted searches through 2026-08-18 found no later company sale, secondary, equity transfer, signed pending exit, concession termination or bankruptcy. The 2025 transaction refinanced debt and funded an equity distribution rather than changing control.

milestones.event: A Morgan Stanley Infrastructure Partners subsidiary acquired an 80% interest through MGT Holdings S.a.r.l.
Morgan Stanley Infrastructure Partners increased its ownership from 80% to 100%.
The consortium led by Fiera Axium Infrastructure completed its 100% acquisition from Morgan Stanley Infrastructure Partners.
Montreal Gateway Terminals pursued a C$440 million refinancing through FA MGT; the financing did not transfer ownership.
